2607.08346.title: Grounded Event Extraction from SEC 8-K Filings with a Fine-Grained Taxonomy
2607.08346.paper_summary: Form 8-K filings are the primary channel through which U.S. public companies disclose material events, but the SEC item codes attached to them are coarse: a single item spans routine administrative changes and chief executive departures, and many of the most market-moving disclosures fall into a catch-all item. Large language models make fine-grained labelling feasible at corpus scale, but only if the labels can be traced to the source text and shown to be reliable. We present a two-stage system that tags 8-K disclosures against a three-tier taxonomy of 119 event types. The first stage constrains output to valid taxonomy entries and anchors every tag to a verbatim quote via fuzzy n-gram validation; the second re-grades each cited quote against the category definition to produce a quality score. Applying the system to 292,984 filings from 2022 to 2026 yields 601,088 grounded event tags, which we release. Over 5,125 stratified tags, an LLM judge finds precision rises monotonically with the quality score, from 12% to 96%, while unsupported tags fall from 8% to near zero. Ablation shows the score is calibrated only when assigned in a dedicated second pass. An event study on unsigned abnormal returns confirms, without any language model, that the taxonomy separates economically distinct events sharing an item code.
2607.08346.paper_summary_zh: Form 8-K 申報是美國上市公司披露重大事件的主要渠道，但附加的 SEC 項目代碼較為粗糙：單一項目涵蓋例行的行政變更和首席執行官的離職，許多對市場影響最大的披露則落入一個包羅萬象的項目中。大型語言模型使得在語料庫規模上進行細緻標記成為可能，但前提是標籤能夠追溯到源文本並顯示其可靠性。我們提出了一個兩階段系統，將 8-K 披露標記對應於 119 種事件類型的三級分類法。第一階段將輸出限制為有效的分類條目，並通過模糊 n-gram 驗證將每個標籤固定於逐字引用；第二階段根據類別定義重新評分每個引用，以產生質量分數。將該系統應用於 2022 至 2026 年的 292,984 份申報，產生 601,088 個有根據的事件標籤，我們將其釋出。在 5,125 個分層標籤中，一個 LLM 評估者發現，精確度隨著質量分數單調上升，從 12% 提高到 96%，而不支持的標籤則從 8% 降至接近零。消融實驗顯示，只有在專門的第二次通過中分配時，分數才會被校準。一項針對未簽名異常回報的事件研究確認，無需任何語言模型，該分類法能夠區分共享項目代碼的經濟上不同的事件。
